native_meaning: The .333333 JumpTo value is the outgoing choreo root-motion driver weight duration. It is not a PuppetAnimation bone pose blend duration.

native_chain.meaning: Registers newly created jumpTo driver with targetWeight1, track+1c blendIn and track+20 blendOut, through10939260.
Driver-list entry stores blendOut at+24, live blend factor at+28; initial entry factor0 and blendIn0 becomes1 on first active update.
JumpTo end removes its listener, requests driver removal with immediate=false; list entry time becomes-1 and indefinite flagfalse, retaining the driver for fade rather than immediate deletion.
Fading entry subtracts dt/blendOut from current factor before evaluation. Factor<=0 leaves the active list. This is linear, not smoothstep/easing and not a fixed pose delay.

A still-positive fading driver continues update(dt), which converts the retained translation velocity into a root displacement each frame. JumpTo action update100e2b60 has ended, so it no longer changes that velocity by target tracking/source gravity.
JumpTo constructs a type9 DeltaTransform driver and selects flag1 (root translation). This is separate from a skeletal PuppetAnimation track.
Root translation output is interpolated with caller supplied blend weight; the other flag2 path handles root rotation. No skeleton joint loop is involved.

actual_gap: BlacklightCommonInfected previously cleared horizontal velocity immediately at landing and handed the full outgoing horizontal velocity to vanilla travel after ordinary cancellation. There was no bounded outgoing root-driver blend matching the native .333333 parameter.
implemented: CommonInfectedLeap.RootExit retains the final horizontal source-driver velocity and uses the exact decoded duration. At20Hz the first evaluation has weight1-.05/duration, about0.85; the seventh evaluation reaches zero. Repeated release cannot restart or replace an active driver.
Real ground contact and ordinary action stop/timeout release the driver. Once released there is no target tracking, source gravity update, probe or late wrist hit from that driver.

BlacklightCommonInfected.travel calls ordinary travel once. Only that call's SELF move is replaced by the mixed horizontal step; no extra move/teleport is appended and the normal baseline velocity is not overwritten with the outgoing root component.

Landing clears duplicate baseline horizontal momentum, so the root tail cannot remain as vanilla inertia after its duration. Ordinary locomotion acceleration may blend in. A new melee/leap cannot begin during the short outgoing tail.

Hurt, capture/consume, NoAI, passenger state, fluid state, horizontal collision or unavailable combat ownership immediately clear the outgoing tail; new external knockback is not erased. Unknown chunk envelope clears the tail and rejects its horizontal step without loading columns.
Same-object readAdditionalSaveData now cancels all transient leap/action clocks as well as flight/root-tail ownership; no transient driver is restored or caught up offline.

Attack generation advances at each new action and every cancellation/end, including readAdditionalSaveData. tickLeap checks retained generation/ownership after swing, hurt and knockback callbacks before writing previous contact, landing clocks, root tail or landing sound. A replaced action is left intact rather than canceled by its old caller.
mc_adaptations: Source linear driver weight and duration are retained. Only X/Z are adapted; vertical momentum, gravity, ground contact and stepping remain vanilla living movement after release, avoiding a retained downward native delta pushing into a floor.
Frozen velocity uses world horizontal axes. The full native local driver priority/normalization graph is not claimed to be reproduced.
Safety cancellation and loaded-chunk guards are MC ownership/collision rules, not newly inferred native JumpTo exit conditions.
No network accessor or shared sound/registry changes. The server remains authoritative for movement; normal position updates expose the result to clients.

CommonInfectedMotion and CommonInfectedModel were reviewed but deliberately unchanged: .333333 is not bone blending. Existing authored10tick landing pose and missing original release/land clips remain explicit incomplete work; no new original skeleton/animation claim.

pending_regressions.limitations: These cases are only authored and statically checked. Real fixture timing and whether the old trajectory reaches its marked landing remain unverified; no claimed test pass.

callback_followup.trigger: Actual AI right-wrist doHurtTarget invokes a victim hurt event whose handler loads a healthy ground snapshot with ordinary XZ Motion into the same attacker. Without a generation guard, the old tickLeap stack resumes, sets LEAP_LANDED and starts a root tail from the newly loaded ordinary velocity.
callback_followup.fix_scope: Common infected action-generation guard only; no shared combat/network transaction changes or original-native claim.
callback_followup.regression: New real GameTest uses Neo LivingIncomingDamageEvent / Forge LivingAttackEvent, armed for this exact prey/attacker. It requires the real wrist callback, loads NoAI=false/OnGround=true plus explicit XZ Motion, and then checks cleared action/punch/landing clocks and zero root-tail weight. It does not directly call hurt or manufacture a damage source.
callback_followup.execution: Authored only, not compiled/run. Sound packet counts and broader vanilla travel reentrancy are not asserted.

player_checks_pending: Leap on flat ground, slab and stair edge: bounded landing glide settles without a second root step, relaunch or persistent sliding.
Interrupt during flight and during landing with damage/capture/NoAI, vehicle entry or fluids: no outgoing root tail fights the new motion owner.
Lose the target or add a wall while airborne: no tracking continuation, late fist damage or movement through cover.
Observe client pose continuity separately: original landing/release skeleton clips are still missing and this root-driver change does not certify visual acceptance.
